from.place: The proof clause invoking Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 20.26.9 (Stacks Tag 06YD): a bounded above complex of flat modules over a ringed space is K-flat.

title: Bounded-above flat complexes are K-flat
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space. Every bounded-above complex of flat \mathcal O_X-module sheaves is K-flat in the sense of [def-pc-kflat-complex].
